name: Kanzaki Akihito
source:
Protagonist of the second story. After his childhood heart problems got worse by time went on, Akihito refuses to go to school and has turned into a shadow of his past self, who used to be good at studying and exercising and got along with everyone.

[spoiler]He's actually in a coma after a failed suicide attempt. The whole story is his dream while being in coma.[/spoiler]
translation:
Protagonist of the second story. After his childhood heart problems got worse by time went on, Akihito refuses to go to school and has turned into a shadow of his past self, who used to be good at studying and exercising and got along with everyone.

[spoiler]He's actually in a coma after a failed suicide attempt. The whole story is his dream while being in coma.[/spoiler]
